killedBy: the persistence controls (issue #249) navigates to the production save ONLY on the second press
why: Removes the arming step, so one press reloads the session onto the real save. Issue #249 requires "a warning and deliberate confirmation immediately before reload", and the two-press arm is what supplies both -- the armed label IS the warning, and the second press IS the reload, so nothing can go stale between confirming and applying. A single-press version still works and still shows the right URL, which is why it needs an entry rather than being caught by the happy path.
